title: Bound Multi-Site Health Summary Site reads while preserving total-count metadata

opportunity.rootCause: The Health Summary endpoint loaded every waf_sites row with ListAsync and then retained only the first bounded limit, causing unnecessary application-side object allocation and row transfer as Site count grew.

implementation: Added a parameterized summary page query with ORDER BY site_id, LIMIT @limit, and COUNT(*) OVER() total-count metadata.
Changed the endpoint to consume the bounded page while preserving totalSites, returnedSites, and truncated response semantics.
Kept the existing summary query budget, health history window, acknowledgement handling, and operator UI contracts intact.

tddRed.reason: The summary endpoint still called ListAsync and the store had no bounded page/count query contract.

boundaries: Large live PostgreSQL Site-count query-plan and latency benchmark; COUNT(*) OVER() still requires database-side count work
CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification
